Workbench.UnknownImplText: There's no conventional implementation {0} in this snapshot.
Workbench.UnknownService: There's no service identity {0} in this snapshot.
Workbench.LifetimeMix: These descriptors have different lifetimes, so the enumerated instances live for different spans.
Workbench.NotAuto: This descriptor was not created by Monica conventional registration.
Workbench.ReplacedNote: Replace removed an earlier descriptor of the same service identity; the snapshot doesn't record what it removed.
Workbench.LogicalNote: An inferred match means the original convention descriptor is absent. Attribution uses the service, lifetime and implementation.

Advice.NotRegistered: Monica resolved {0} as {1} ({2}), but it doesn't expose any service type, so nothing was registered. Injecting it or its interface throws "Unable to resolve service".
Advice.NotRegisteredNext: Implement an interface whose name matches the class name (for example {0}), or expose services explicitly with {1}.
Advice.ConcreteOnly: Monica registered only the concrete type for {0}. Consider exposing an abstraction when other components should depend on it.
Advice.Bypass: The plain type descriptor at #{1} is registered after the convention's Monica activation factory (#{2}). GetService<{0}>() returns its instance, CachedServiceProvider is never assigned, and Logger access throws "Cached service provider is not initialized".
Advice.BypassNext: Remove the manual registration at #{0} so the conventional one applies.
Advice.Elsewhere: {0} resolves to {1} ({2}, #{3}), not to the conventional {4} ({5}). The conventional implementation appears only in IEnumerable<{0}>.
Advice.ElsewhereNext: If the replacement is intended (a decorator or a transitional implementation), nothing to do; otherwise remove the later registration, or state the intent with [Dependency(ReplaceServices = true)].
Advice.Twice: {0} has {1} naming the same implementation. GetService returns #{2}; resolving IEnumerable<{0}> creates one instance per descriptor.
Advice.TwiceNext: Remove the manual registration and keep the conventional one.

Workbench.TryAddNote: TryAdd adds only when the identity doesn't exist yet; a skipped exposure leaves no trace in the snapshot.

ActivationTips.Monica: The type implements ICachedServiceProviderAccessor (ServiceBase, DomainService, EventHandlerBase); a Monica factory creates it and assigns CachedServiceProvider.
ActivationTips.Forward: A singleton or scoped type exposed as several services: this exposure forwards to the concrete registration, so every exposure shares one instance.
ActivationTips.Factory: Created by the delegate given at registration; the actual type isn't known without invoking it.
ActivationTips.Direct: Created from its type or instance.

Workbench.FindingsDesc: Covers conventional registration across the whole host, independently of the Service resolution filters, including implementations that produced no descriptor.
Workbench.FindingSearchPh: Search source types, assemblies or exposed services
Workbench.NoFindingsCalm: No conventional implementation needs attention. Implementations that expose only their concrete type are under Concrete only.
Workbench.NoFindings: No convention issues in this evidence set.

Consequence.ConcreteOnly: Only the concrete type is registered

Workbench.MatrixTitle: By lifetime and kind of what resolves

Workbench.SegmentAction: Enter opens this segment in Service resolution

Caption.Idle: Hover to read a descriptor. Scroll over the tape to zoom horizontally or drag across the lanes to select a range.

Workbench.FixedTip: The snapshot is built once, after the host finalizes its service collection, and stays the same until the process restarts. Refresh re-reads the same registry.
Workbench.Stale: The latest read of the registry failed. The page still shows the snapshot read at {0}. The service collection is finalized only at process start, so this evidence still describes the running process.
Workbench.UnavailableTitle: Registration diagnostics are off on this host
Workbench.Unavailable: Dependency-injection diagnostics are captured only when {0} is on. Turn it on and restart the host to capture the registration snapshot.
Workbench.LoadFailed: The finalized registration snapshot could not be read. Retry or check the host logs for details.
Workbench.RefreshFailed: Couldn't re-read the registry. Showing the last snapshot read.
Workbench.Reread: Re-read: the registry is unchanged since {0}.

ReasonTips.NotRegistered: Monica found a lifetime but no service type to expose, so no descriptor was created.
ReasonTips.BypassesActivation: A later plain type registration wins; resolving it skips Monica activation, so CachedServiceProvider stays unset.
ReasonTips.ResolvesElsewhere: The last descriptor of an exposed service names another implementation, which GetService returns.
ReasonTips.RegisteredTwice: Several descriptors of one service identity name this implementation.
ReasonTips.ConcreteOnly: Only the concrete type is registered; expected for controllers and event handlers that are resolved by type.
